description: Runs the session instance's evaluate() and returns its JSON result verbatim. args are forwarded as the evaluate options object: { cohortWindowMs } for herd-phase / activity-phase (scoping is part of the law for room streams - use 86400000), { asOfTs } for the other kinds. Omit args to evaluate with defaults. Every result is advisory (enforcement: "none").

args.description: Evaluate options forwarded verbatim, e.g. { cohortWindowMs: 86400000 } or { asOfTs: 1730000000000 }.

name: evaluate
title: Evaluate a signal session
